d: Serbia’s student-led movement has scored a historic election victory, defeating longtime leader Aleksandar Vučić after nearly two years of protests. The Students’ List, an anti-establishment platform without a formal leader or spokesperson, is projected to win more than 140 seats in Serbia’s 250-seat parliament. The movement grew out of demonstrations following the 2024 Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse, which killed 16 people and triggered public anger over alleged corruption.
